<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak at m/z 179.0946 likely corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]+. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral mass of approximately 178.087 Da. The formula that matches this exact mass within typical instrument tolerance and contains only C, H, and O is C₁₁H₁₄O₂. This formula also satisfies the nitrogen rule (even nominal mass, zero nitrogens) and yields a reasonable degree of unsaturation (DBE = 5). Therefore, the molecular formula of the sample compound is C11H14O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C11H14O2</final_answer>
